title: Schedule a pickup
body:
Drivers need to book pickups for packages that are ready to go.

Add a new module `parcelo/pickups.py` with `schedule_pickup(shipment_id, window_start)`. It creates a `Pickup` with an id, the shipment id, `window_start`, and `scheduled_at` (when it was booked), saves it in a new `pickups` collection on the store, and returns it. Define the `Pickup` dataclass in `parcelo/models.py`, and add the `pickups` collection to `parcelo/store.py` (cleared in `reset()` like the others).

Scheduling a pickup for a shipment that does not exist must fail. It must also fail for a shipment that is not in status "created".
